_meta.purpose: B2B lane - posts aimed at EMPLOYERS to get them to post roles / hire early-career talent on Internwise. The generator picks one unused angle per day and authors a bespoke design around it. Audience = hiring managers, founders, HR at UK SMEs and scale-ups.
_meta.source: Benefits verified from internwise.co.uk (homepage + /employers), fetched 24 Aug 2026. Claims corrected per brand direction 01 Sep 2026.

verified_facts.candidates: ~398k records in the database; show rounded as 400,000 (NOT '400K+' - the true figure is under 400k). Call them 'registered candidates' or 'students & graduates', never 'active'.
verified_facts.process: Post in minutes -> browse candidates -> shortlist & interview -> onboard & track progress
verified_facts.register: Register in ~3 minutes (free account) and post unlimited vacancies
verified_facts.featured: Featured Employer option boosts number of applications
verified_facts.no_prescreen: Internwise does NOT pre-screen/vet candidates - never claim 'pre-screened', 'vetted' or 'ready to work'.
verified_facts.no_named_orgs: Never name specific companies (e.g. Nike/Oracle/O2/Man Utd/Penguin) - use generic 'household names' / '14,000+ UK employers'.

rules: Only use benefits/stats from `verified_facts`. Do NOT invent pricing - never claim 'free to post' or a commission %; 'free account' is OK.
Never say candidates are 'active', 'pre-screened', 'vetted' or 'ready to work'.
Tone: confident, useful, not salesy. Lead with the benefit to the employer.
